trello.name: Add queue depth alerting for worker fleet
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Add alerting on queue depth for the entire worker fleet (not just payments), with consistent thresholds: warning at 1,000 jobs, page at 5,000. Complete in one pass across all workers.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic with dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Fix _process_with_retry in payment_worker.py: implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap retries, and route failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back instead of re-enqueuing at the front of the main queue. Add tests simulating processor 503 responses.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pools
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. In one config change: bump the DB connection pool from the default 20 to 100, and split worker and API connection pools so they no longer share the same pool.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya (Kofi to confirm with her). Update the payment incident runbook: replace old Kibana links with current logging links, document the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised during Tuesday's outage, and verify escalation phone numbers are current (at least one still routes to someone who left last year).

trello.name: Automate status page updates on checkout alert
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Wire the status page to the checkout error rate alert so that when the alert fires, the status page automatically flips to 'investigating' with a template message via the status provider's API. Start with the checkout alert; can be extended to other alerts later.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a controlled chaos test plan for payment processor failover: staging first, then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. Plan must be reviewed in two weeks before any execution. No execution until the review. Draft first.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Upgrade Redis from EOL version 6.0 to 7.2. Account for a config rename and changed persistence defaults. Requires a proper change window, not a casual Friday deploy. Schedule with the infra calendar.

trello.name: Write and distribute incident timeline doc
trello.desc: Owner: Ines. Write up the incident timeline document tonight and send it out tomorrow.
